evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed; purge effectiveness and oxygen exclusion during growth cannot be verified.
Temperature 750.4 °C and Ar flow 100.6 sccm closely track setpoints of 750 °C and 100 sccm; heater power is 44.7% and status is running.
Pressure has risen through 3.025 and 3.046 Torr to 3.131 Torr despite approximately constant temperature and Ar flow; without operating limits or reference data, this trend does not identify a fault.
